data.title: 夏洛特 · 晨光凌乱床单的新娘低喃
data.description: 假日的晨光铺满纯白床垫，睡裙褪在床尾。夏洛特双腿与你亲密交缠，双臂紧紧搂着你的脖颈，眼角闪着动情的泪花，在温热的耳语中轻诉“我已经是你的新娘了”。
data.location: sunlit bedroom with rumpled white linen sheets
data.action: lying tangled under sheets, arms tightly around partner neck, bare legs entwined, teary blissful smile, flushed skin
data.lighting: pure white morning sunlight streaming across bed and skin
data.mood: eternal bridal devotion, profound emotional warmth, heavenly bliss
data.promptProse: Tangled in rumpled white sheets in morning light, Charlotte hugs partner neck tight with tears of joy and flushed bare shoulders.
data.animaCaption: Charlotte embracing closely in messy morning sheets with joyful tears.
